title: Codex 0.156.1 and later exit at startup when a sandbox holds a lent ChatGPT login
foundBy: session agent, re-recording the agent fixtures for a bump to Codex 0.157.1

evidence.verified: In a lent Firecracker sandbox with Codex 0.157.1, a real turn answered, and the lender answered the discovery and lent the model calls. The same sandbox without the new variable failed with the error above. With the host's own login shared into a sandbox, Codex 0.157.1 recorded a real turn through cs-vcr and replayed it with 0 misses and 0 upstream calls. The four Codex fixtures were re-recorded on 0.157.1, and `make ci CI_SLIM_FLAGS='--slim --rebuild-base'` passed on bd96377 with all 14 agent replays.

resolution: The lender answers Codex's workspace discovery itself for a lent login, under a second name, cs-lender-chatgpt (R146a). For a shared login cs-vcr answers it, under cs-vcr-chatgpt, which the agent matrix now points a shared Codex at. Each answer names the account and a concrete HTTPS origin, which Codex requires. The image's Codex is now 0.157.1.
details:
On a ChatGPT login, Codex's TUI now makes a workspace routing discovery call to chatgpt.com at startup. When that call fails, Codex prints `Error: account/read failed during TUI bootstrap: account/read failed: workspace routing discovery failed (code -32603)` and exits 1.

A sandbox created with `--lend-agent-login codex` cannot make that call succeed. Its side calls to chatgpt.com are blocked by default. With `--block-side-calls=false` the call carries the sandbox's fabricated token, and Codex exits on `workspace routing discovery unauthorized (401)` instead. A sandbox given the real login with `--inherit-agent-login codex` starts normally.

Each stable release was started with a lent login in the slim image. Releases 0.152.1, 0.153.4, 0.154.0 and 0.155.1 reach the prompt. Releases 0.156.1, 0.157.0 and 0.157.1 exit, and 0.156.0 was not tested. The fixture recording fails the same way in both codex-login cases, because cs-vcr refuses chatgpt.com in the shared case as well.

This holds the image's Codex pin at 0.155.1. Moving past it needs the lender, and cs-vcr in replay, to answer the discovery call for a lent login.

To reproduce, build the image with `CODEX_VERSION=0.156.1`, create a sandbox with `--lend-agent-login codex`, and run `cs-codex` inside it.

notes.text: 804ee40 has the lender answer the discovery itself for a lent login, under a second name, cs-lender-chatgpt (R146a). In a lent Firecracker sandbox with Codex 0.157.1 installed, a real turn answered, and the lender answered the discovery once and lent the model calls. Without the new variable, the same sandbox failed with the error above. Codex 0.155.1 still works through the change, and all 14 agent replays pass on an image rebuilt with it. The pin stays at 0.155.1 for two reasons. The fixture recording's codex-login-shared case still fails, because cs-vcr refuses chatgpt.com there. And 0.157 opens the dialog in SBX-085.

The shared case is fixed too. Now cs-vcr answers the discovery itself, as its record VCR-044 describes. Commit 3ca7df4 pins that build and points the agent matrix's shared Codex login at it under a second name, cs-vcr-chatgpt. Codex 0.157.1 recorded and replayed a real turn that way with the host's own login, and all 14 agent replays pass. What still holds the pin at 0.155.1 is the dialog in SBX-085.
